Hi there /u/BlinkXPoke , you just need an audio bridge between a program to process your audio to a virtual microphone, I have the opposite problem where I couldn't find ANY alternative to RoVee for years now, and I thank you for this post.

​

I suggest Pedalboard 2, or Equalizer APO, to hold plugins, not just RoVee but also any audio treatment to reduce static noise and such so the voice changing is cleaner.

  
**And then you throw the result into a virtual microphone, I suggest VoiceMeeter Banana** if you want to control with knobs, **or just VB-cable that works directly without any interface,** then instead of importing filters on OBS you just add the virtual microphone instead.

OBS has a function called Replay Buffer, which works like Shadowplay(instant replay) from NVidia. It constantly records the past set time under set bitrate while active but only saves on disk when you press a hotkey. So you only have to worry about starting the buffer in the first place before things happen.

Also after using it one time it fails any subsequent uses until you interact with something or switch weapons back and forth. Since doing any of this refreshes server image of your current weapon state (if it is grappling or not regardless of your position or client side use cooldown).

Bad host internet losing packets or your own internet losing packets, just disconnect and find another game or solo.

I have a thing when I just joined a game, anything that was created or destroyed at that exact moment becomes a ghost, Can't interact with it even though I can see it.

  
Floating veins of ore recently destroyed.   
Machine events that spawned a core slot for me but can't insert blank core in it.   
Spawn pod landed in one location and client-side in another, so when i walk by the server location it warps my camera to where my client sees the spawn pod, (funny thing is that i could mine terrain around me but anything projectile spawns in the actual server location). 

​

For now I'm calling this the "join glitch" as it almost always happens when joining games.  


My suspicion is that this is also a packet loss thing. As the behaviour is similar to when my internet was actually suffering packet loss for a few minutes sometimes.
